issue_context.title: Add right click option to SFTP to create new folder/empty file/...
issue_context.body:
For SFTP, and coming from MobaXterm, there was the option to right-click and create a new folder or new file at the current SFTP path location.

This is specially useful when setting up a new server that needs a folder created before drag-drop files into SFTP for upload.

So the idea is to have a right-click menu on SFTP that allows to create a new folder/new file/.... instead of having to go to the command line.

Here's a screenshot of the options available on MobaXterm:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/396734/142386340-f86f7ef8-97ae-415c-a135-61054f94c2e8.png)

review_comments: Some nitpicks on the architecture: I'd prefer if `SFTPCreateDirectoryModalComponent` just returned (via `modalInstance.close`) the new name, and `SFTPPanelComponent` would then handle actual creation of the folder. This way you don't have to send the `SSHSession` around.
